Model and data

Model: Random Forest regressor trained in Python (scikit-learn) on your Salary_Data.csv, then run here in the browser. Rows with blank cells and duplicate rows were removed, education labels were made consistent, and job titles with fewer than 5 people are grouped as "Other". Accuracy is measured on 20% of rows the model never saw. The CSV salaries are in US dollars and were converted to rupees at ₹94.46 per dollar (rate of 22 Oct 2026).
